<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex23012023-09-18-101" status="unreviewed" ana="corpusmd:colophon">  
            <milestone unit="section" n="Colophon (188b4-188b7)"/>
           <l> <rs type="work">ma rig bdun sel bde legs pa yon tan gzhi </rs>||</l> <l><note type="gloss">bya</note>s**** bgrod ba chig [=gcig] pa'i lam || </l>
           <l> zab yangs thub pas gsungs pa'i spyod pa'i cha|| || </l>
            <l><lb n="188b5"/> dgos 'dod kun gyi dpal? 'gyur <rs type="person" ana="">'gon [=mgon] po</rs>s phye || </l>
            <l>de'i rjes 'brangs <rs type="work">rnam nges gzhung 'grel pa</rs> mdzad || </l>
            <l>de dag la brten <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3712">seng ge bzang po</rs> yis || </l>
            <l>mdo'i thun mong rgyan gyur gsal mdzad don || </l>
            <l>mig gis sgra ltar 'phags pa'i bla'i yul ||</l>
            <l>blo sman<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3918">bdag</rs> gis rtogs par nus min pas ||</l>
            <l><rs type="person" ana="">grol sde 'gos? kyi 'grel </rs>dang <rs type="work">ti ka</rs>|| </l>
            <l>|<rs type="work">'buM phrag gnyis kyi 'grel rgyan</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3807">shes rab 'bar</rs> ||</l>
            <l/><rs type="person" ana="">ye shes tshul <lb n="188b6"/> khrims bkra shis brtson 'grus</rs><!--maybe BDR PORK1459 pa tshab dga' ba gdong pa gnas brtan ye shes tshul khrims--> dang || 
            <l><rs type="person" ana="">seng ge rnam gnyis grags rdo rje</rs> dang ||</l>
            <l><rs type="person" ana="">brtson 'grus mtha['] can</rs> rnams kyi <rs type="work">man ngag</rs> dang ||</l> 
            <l>gzhung don rigs pas yun du spyad pa las ||</l> 
            <l>log rtog brgya phrag bsal nas leg[s] bshad rnaMs ||</l></seg></TEI>
